strings: m_c mewls, snuggling up to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} parent as they anxiously await the verdict. r_c0 is confident that m_c's lack of a leg won't slow {PRONOUN/m_c/object} down. The new family is left to bond, relieved and purring.
It's immediately clear that m_c might take longer to find {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} feet. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} been born without one of the usual set.
